title: vl05: diagonalisation defined via U: H -> L^2(R) and multiplication by a(x)

legacy.gap_tjo: The finite-dimensional definition (an orthonormal basis in which A is diagonal, equivalently a unitary U with UAU^dagger diagonal) replaces it in the Kern (D97); the multiplication-operator form is the general spectral theorem (c03.thm.spektral-allgemein, Vertiefung c03.v7).

reason: For H = C^N a unitary onto L^2(R) does not exist, and the general statement (every self-adjoint operator is unitarily equivalent to a multiplication operator) needs a measure space, not L^2(R), and self-adjointness. The sentence mixes the finite-dimensional notion with the general spectral theorem.
